description: Conflict raised; overlap and boundary cases wait for the PO.

analysis.summary: Shipping fee rules; AC-1 and AC-2 overlap for subtotals between 50 and 100 EUR.

acceptance_criteria.text: Orders with a subtotal over 50 EUR ship for free.
Orders with a subtotal under 100 EUR pay a flat shipping fee of 4.99 EUR.
The shipping cost is shown in the cart summary before checkout.

findings.text: AC-1 and AC-2 both apply to subtotals between 50 and 100 EUR: free shipping or 4.99 EUR?
Is a subtotal of exactly 50 EUR or exactly 100 EUR covered by either rule?

risks.title: Wrong shipping fee charged
risks.description: Shoppers may be over- or under-charged in the overlap range.

test_cases.title: Subtotal above both thresholds ships for free
test_cases.objective: Verify: Subtotal above both thresholds ships for free.

steps.action: Open the cart with a subtotal of 120.00 EUR.
steps.expected_result: The cart summary shows shipping 0.00 EUR.

test_cases.title: Subtotal below both thresholds pays 4.99 EUR shipping
test_cases.objective: Verify: Subtotal below both thresholds pays 4.99 EUR shipping.

steps.action: Open the cart with a subtotal of 30.00 EUR.
steps.expected_result: The cart summary shows shipping 4.99 EUR.

test_cases.title: Subtotal in the overlap range
test_cases.objective: Assumes free shipping wins in the overlap (F-1 unanswered).

steps.action: Open the cart with a subtotal of 75.00 EUR.
steps.expected_result: The cart summary shows shipping 0.00 EUR.

steps.action: Open the cart with a subtotal of 50.00 EUR.
steps.expected_result: The cart summary shows shipping 4.99 EUR.

test_cases.title: Non-positive subtotal shows no shipping fee
test_cases.objective: Verify: Non-positive subtotal shows no shipping fee.

steps.action: Remove every product so the cart is empty.
steps.expected_result: The cart summary shows no shipping cost line.
